{{Youmay|the suspended-animation casket|the [[suspended animation capsule]]}}
A '''suspended-animation casket''' was a technology that allowed for the extended preservation of a living being in a state of [[Suspended animation/Legends|suspended animation]]. After [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Sander Delvardus]]'s mistress, [[Seledra-Zin]], was injured during an altercation with Delvardus, he arranged for a suspended-animation casket for her to be installed in his personal [[Blinking Eyes: Quarters|quarters]] aboard his [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], the [[Brilliant (Star Destroyer)|''Brilliant'']].<ref name="Despoilers2">{{SW|url=news/the-imperial-warlords-despoilers-of-an-empire-part-2|series=The Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref>
